title: Core Quintet #45
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Turkish woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, cool and composed, braided hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework — a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, pale porcelain skin, deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones, long teased jet-black hair with silver streaks, a cold, poised expression, cool and composed, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame.

Left woman's footwear: extreme cobalt platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Korean woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, pale porcelain skin, deep burgundy-black shadow smudged heavily beneath both eyes, sharp black liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a glossy near-black wine lip, sharply contoured cheekbones, long straight jet-black hair, a cold, poised expression, sultry, high ponytail hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern — a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.

Center woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult German woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, cool and composed, curly hair, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif — a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense engraved floral facets filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Right woman's footwear: extreme silver needle heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, demure and soft, high ponytail hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer — a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, wide silver chrome bands following every deep crease, dense zigzag linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme silver chrome platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 5, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 landscape 8K.
